E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer and Her Sisters: A self-help expert prompts Homer to do something unthinkable: get to know Patty and Selma. (S36 Ep9/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Parents Just Don't Understand: Adam and Barry write a song but don't get the reaction they were expecting from Murray. Beverly repeatedly calls Erica at college. (S5 Ep9) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Blackberry's: Gordon visits New Jersey to save floundering soul food restaurant Blackberry's. Owner Shelley doesn't want to hear his advice, but then Gordon finds a dead mouse. (S5 Ep1) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: While the Keane family feud, Caleb's health takes a turn for the worse, and Vicky is reminded why it's important to get better. Elsewhere, a resident is threatened into silence.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Frankie's determination to help Caleb causes accusations to fly in the Keane household. Abigail pushes Dee Dee to audition for the lead role in the school play.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sheep.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4Plus1.uk.description: In Lincolnshire, former soldier Scott is under his partner Clare's command. Su and Dylan serve up a pagan ritual and a Gary Barlow tribute. And Adele and Dave recreate an officers' mess.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Burger Kitchen (Part 2/2): In the second half of a two-part Nightmare in LA, can Gordon Ramsay bring together the fragmented Saffron family and save their failing restaurant? (S5 Ep4) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Luigi's: Gordon Ramsay travels to Orange County, Southern California, to try to save Italian restaurant Luigi's from disaster. (S5 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
E4Plus1.uk.description: Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments, from snow fails to kids who really try our patience! (S33 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: Kiss My Butler: On Geoffrey's birthday, Will sets him up with a blind date... who Will promptly falls for. Naomi Campbell guest stars. (S1 Ep10/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: Courting Disaster: Success goes to Will's head when he becomes the superstar of Carlton's high-school basketball team. (S1 Ep11/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gone Abie Gone: Grampa goes missing. Can Homer and Marge find him by following clues from when he used to work in a restaurant? (S24 Ep4/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Penny-Wiseguys: When mobster Fat Tony has to do jury service, he puts mild-mannered accountant Dan Gillick (voiced by Steve Carell) in charge of his criminal organisation. (S24 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer and Her Sisters: A self-help expert prompts Homer to do something unthinkable: get to know Patty and Selma. (S36 Ep9/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Man Who Flew Too Much: Homer's old bowling team, the Pin Pals, reunite. But disaster befalls them on their helicopter ride to the state championships. (S36 Ep10/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goldberg Girls: Beverly seeks her children's advice on assembling a circle of friends for her later years. Geoff's romantic gestures begin to annoy Erica. (S5 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dinner with the Goldbergs: Geoff takes Erica out to a restaurant with her family to celebrate her birthday, but dinner with the Goldbergs is no ordinary meal... (S5 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Patriot Games: Alex faces her worst nightmare: having to share the Valedictorian title with her number one competitor, Sunjay. (S6 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Crying Out Loud: Phil, Luke and Haley force Alex to come out and celebrate her senior ditch day, but they end up taking an unexpected detour. (S6 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: American Skyper: The whole family are at Jay and Gloria's for Alex's graduation party, except for Phil, who's figured out a way to be there using Skype and a robotic vessel. (S6 Ep24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: She of Little Faith: Richard Gere (guest starring as himself) convinces Lisa to become a Buddhist after Bart and Homer burn the church down with a rocket. (S13 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sweets and Sour Marge: Springfield is declared the fattest town on Earth when Homer's attempt to create the world's biggest human pyramid goes disastrously wrong. (S13 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Half-Decent Proposal: Marge's incredibly rich high school prom date Artie makes Homer and Marge an indecent proposal they can't afford to turn down. (S13 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Jaws Wired Shut: Homer becomes a good listener and a calming influence when his jaw is wired shut after he runs into a statue. But Marge is disturbed by his newfound serenity. (S13 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Jonah's claims shake his family. Dee Dee sabotages her audition. And it's full steam ahead for one couple as they plan their wedding...

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Abbott Elementary
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Gregory's Garden Goofballs: Gregory's nonplussed when kids start showing him respect. Barbara's shocked when Tariq starts dating a student's mum. (S3 Ep3/14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: Nice Lady: Will finds himself out of his depth with the teenage daughter of a British lord. (S1 Ep20/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: Love at First Fight: When one of Vivian's brightest college students starts dating Will, her grades plummet, threatening her future plans. (S1 Ep21/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Ramsay's Kitchen...
